answer: Collateral stops sybils only when it cannot be reused. Each earning address funds a single-owner vault whose spend script names that key alone; a colliding claim confiscates both balances. Challenges travel a one-lane canyon: a serial query asking one vault at a time for a seed-stamped receipt. A shared pot cannot answer twice before the deadline, so each fabricated identity stands as its own island of locked funds. Protocol parameter, not a market price: 80 POA per vault, so 150 clones freeze 12,000 POA until each script matures.
